No matter what your stance on abortion is, we have collectively built a world that fails the children brought into it.

If you advocate for the right to life, you have a moral obligation to advocate for a safe, supportive world for those children to grow up in. Instead, marginalized youth face pervasive bullying, families are crushed by rising healthcare and childcare costs, and the system fails to protect children with special needs from physical abuse.

Furthermore, our education system lacks the fundamental tools and training required to raise and support these children, while our justice system lacks the strict enforcement needed to protect them if they lose their parents. Under these broken conditions, choosing abortion becomes a response to institutional abandonment.
